story.title: Our story
story.lead: A home kitchen in Karnataka, a student with ₹2,500, and a lot of chocolate.

start.title: How it started
start.text: Hema started Dream Kitchen while she was still a student, with ₹2,500 and a love for making chocolate. Order by order, she grew it into a loved home brand.

fresh.title: Handmade, and made fresh for you
fresh.text: Everything is made by hand after you order. That is why nothing waits on a shelf, and why each order needs a few days.

teach.title: Teaching others
teach.text: Hema also teaches chocolate classes, so you can make these treats in your own kitchen too.

instagram.title: See what Hema is making
instagram.text: New treats and behind-the-scenes from her kitchen, on Instagram.

contact.title: Contact Dream Kitchen
contact.lead: Call Hema, or chat on WhatsApp.
contact.callText: Order, ask about a delivery or a class, on the phone.
contact.whatsappText: For questions. Orders are placed and paid on the website.

order.a: Choose your treats on the Menu, then tap Continue in the cart. Fill in your address, check your order, and pay by UPI on the website. You get an order ID to track it.

pay.a: By UPI on the website: scan the QR code or tap “Pay with a UPI app”, then enter the 12-digit UPI reference. Hema confirms your payment, usually within a few hours.

courier.q: Where do you deliver, and what does courier cost?
courier.a: All over India. One courier charge per order: {smallKa} within Karnataka and {smallOut} outside, or {largeKa} / {largeOut} when the order has a 500 g or 700 g Delight Box.

when.q: When will my order be sent?
when.a: Everything is made fresh after you order and dispatched after {days} business days (Monday to Saturday). Drawings need extra time. You pick the dispatch date at checkout; delivery time then depends on the courier.

track.q: How do I track my order?
track.a: Open Track Order and enter your order ID and phone number. You’ll see each step, and the courier’s tracking number once it is shipped.

name.q: Can I have a name or a drawing on the box?
name.a: Yes, on any Delight Box: a name is free, a drawing is {drawingPrice}. There is also a Drawing Chocolate Bar on the Customize page.

ragi.a: Our brownies made with ragi flour instead of maida. Tap “Make it Ragi” when you choose a brownie box.

change.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
change.a: Call {phone} as soon as you can, and Hema will tell you what is possible.
